action.action-desc: Mr. Bera introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To authorize use of rental assistance amounts for individuals and families from Afghanistan, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Housing for Afghan Allies Act of 2021.

subsection.header: Fiscal Year 2021 Consolidated Appropriations Act funds
subsection.text: Subsection (c) of section 501 of subtitle A of title V of division N of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021 (15 U.S.C. 9058a(c)) is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

paragraph.header: Use for individuals and families from Afghanistan
paragraph.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this section, an eligible grantee may use not more than 25 percent of funds provided from a payment made under this section to provide financial assistance to pay rent, utilities, and home energy costs for any individual who is, or any household comprised of members who—

subparagraph.text: are citizens or nationals of Afghanistan;
are present within the United States; and

clause.text: been granted special immigrant status as described in section 602(b) of the Afghan Allies Protection Act of 2009 (8 U.S.C. 1101 note); or

subsection.text: Subsection (d) of section 3201 of the American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 (15 U.S.C. 9058c(d)) is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph:
